Critch gives birational parametrization, semialgebraic membership testing, and generic two-point label-swapping fibers for a single binary hidden Markov model.

source_verification_receipts.version: LNCS 33, Automata Theory and Formal Languages, 1975, pp. 134-183
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Collins's CAD is an exact quantifier-elimination method for real closed fields.
The survey covers exact real-algebraic algorithms and their complexity, including CAD in the broader quantifier-elimination landscape.

The article reduces discrete causal problems to polynomial programs, uses dual relaxation and spatial branch-and-bound, reports successively refined valid outer ranges, and provides epsilon-sharpness for incomplete computation.
The paper studies finite mixtures with observable mixture-weight variation that leaves component distributions unchanged and characterizes the resulting compatible-mixture restrictions.
The paper studies confidence regions for identified sets and known images under iid sampling, with asymptotic pointwise and uniform coverage conditions.
